title: deps-report
summary: Produces a third-party dependency rollup from an index: which external units/libraries an indexed codebase depends on

surfaces.usage: drag-lint deps-report --db <file.sqlite> [--db ...] [--depth N] [--edges] [--all-sources] [--name <pat>] [--format text|json|csv] [--output <file>] (third-party dependency rollup)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Dependency Report (third-party rollup)...
